SORAMOD-KINGDOM_KEY.description: At the start of your first turn, choose a card to [gold]Retain[/gold] this turn.
SORAMOD-KINGDOM_KEY.flavor: The manifestation of your heart's strength.\nCan never be separated from its owner.
SORAMOD-KINGDOM_KEY.title: Kingdom Key
SORAMOD-ULTIMA_WEAPON.description: At the start of your first turn, choose a card to [gold]Retain[/gold] this combat.
SORAMOD-ULTIMA_WEAPON.flavor: An incredible keyblade earned by a difficult ascent.\nOnly one keyblade is above this.
SORAMOD-ULTIMA_WEAPON.title: Ultima Weapon
SORAMOD-GAZING_EYE.flavor: The master’s eye sees all that has happened and all that will transpire.
SORAMOD-GAZING_EYE.title: Gazing Eye
SORAMOD-GOLDEN_EYES.description: Removes a random Curse. Choose two attacks to enchant with Corrupted.
SORAMOD-GOLDEN_EYES.flavor: Though the creatures of darkness hide in shadow, their gleaming golden eyes give themselves away.
SORAMOD-GOLDEN_EYES.title: Golden Eyes
SORAMOD-BOOK_OF_PROPHECIES.description: Upon pickup, replace the Act 3 Map with a single special path and a different boss.
SORAMOD-BOOK_OF_PROPHECIES.flavor: "On that land shall darkness prevail and light expire."\nThe future has already been written.
SORAMOD-BOOK_OF_PROPHECIES.title: Book Of Prophecies
SORAMOD-MELDING_RECIPE.description: Adds Meld as a campfire option.
SORAMOD-MELDING_RECIPE.flavor: When you could create elixirs, powers, even life itself - what could stop you?
SORAMOD-MELDING_RECIPE.title: Melding Recipe
